conceptZh: 廚師動物把麵團丟向天空，小分身學他慢一拍亂丟，最後麵團飛上天，「穴」下面的「工」空出一片藍天。
object: a rotund cartoon chef animal in a tall hat, a wad of pizza dough, and a tiny mimicking mini-chef
morph: the dough flies up and the cover 穴 appears over the beam 工, leaving open blue sky between
creativeAngle: 模仿：小廚師慢一拍學大廚師丟麵團，兩次都丟歪，最後麵團飛上天空，「穴」蓋在「工」上，剛好留出空空的一片天。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and breezy, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-sky-blue backdrop that fades lighter toward a pale cream floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated emerald-green Traditional Chinese glyph 空, the 穴 cover on top of the 工 beam below, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original rotund cartoon chef bear in a tall white hat and apron, flinging pizza dough with far more confidence than accuracy; a second, tiny mini-chef bear copies him one beat late; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the chef bear spins a lump of dough on his finger, grandly tosses it straight up, and the first spoken 空 lands as the dough sails up out of frame, leaving the sky empty above him; the mini-chef copies a beat late and tosses his tiny dough sideways. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the dough comes down on the big chef's tall hat with a flop, the mini-chef's dough lands on the big one's head too, and the stack makes his hat twice as tall; a green 穴 shape drops from the top like a roof over the two of them; the second spoken 空 lands as the chef bear pops the hat off and the dough slides down his nose. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): both chefs point up at a green 工 beam which slides in from below, locking under the cover 穴 with a click, leaving a wide open patch of clear sky between the strokes; the word 天空 is spoken as a little cloud drifts through that open space and a single dough-ball star twinkles past, both chefs gazing up with open mouths. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 空 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in emerald green; the big chef and the mini-chef sit at the side bumping hat to hat in a mirrored little sway, one beat apart, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「空、空、天空」, read as ㄎㄨㄥ、ㄎㄨㄥ、ㄊㄧㄢ ㄎㄨㄥ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
